items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: Because our chief was still down here, the custom house, Chief Cooper.

ctx.x: I remember one time, excuse me for interrupting, you were telling us how, I think it was up when you were playing at the Paddock or at the Mardi Gras, one of those two places one night. You were talking quite a while about when you played at the Navy band, you went up there and they recognized immediately that you had a different kind of a beat.

I did, yeah. I did, yeah. Well, I was, when the band used to drill out on the fields, we had lots of drummers up there from the north, didn't understand the parade music. And I made all together two bass drums, two drummers, with good orchestra drummers. And I learned them how to play the bass drum in parade style. They already know the music for dance band, but they didn't understand the New Orleans style. And our band, the place of taking the 8th week training up there, we stood up there 3 months and 21 days.…

Can you pin down and tell us what is the difference between the New Orleans beat and the other, can you explain any of that? Well I wouldn't know that. I didn't know that. Can you explain any of that?
